Skeptic verdicts were CONFIRMED or PARTIALLY; 8 of 12 lowered a severity and none refuted a claim (G2:78; table G2:24-36).
The design gave one skeptic per P0 and per invariant-touching P1; the 12 skeptics were used up by the first four analysts to finish (O-04, O-06, O-08, O-03) (G2:13-16).

Severity was re-set by Fable at G2 with no materiality skeptic; the file quotes 'Severity is after correction' (G2:98-99).

The Fable gates ran with 0 subagents ('no fan-out'); their main-session cost is not in G1 or G2, and a later session's record says before the first compaction every call re-sent up to 944k tokens (HR:72-73).

S-07b returned blocked DOCKER_ENGINE_DOWN because the Docker engine was not up before W1; the agent returned the designed blocked value, so the fallback worked but the precondition did not hold (G1:60-61; docs/program/evidence/w1/S-07b.txt:3).

Web research ran and the re-check returned tool_status=web_ok (docs/program/evidence/w2/web-recheck.txt:2); but G1:81 says bodies were 403 and O-01 was given the gh route (G1:103-104); no web_unavailable result is on record.

The command-agent rules (600000 ms timeout, fixed container names, no re-issue of mutating commands) never ran in W1 because S-07b was blocked; the design marks Appendix A superseded for phase work since 2026-11-13 because this machine cannot create Docker networks (D:632-635).
